The saying *"beer before liquor, never been sicker; liquor before beer, you're in the clear"* is a myth. Scientific research shows that the order in which you drink alcohol does not determine how sick or hungover you get.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStwEBxCJF13myxvBNJsI58wMEJsz-4zyWTVYMuWSpGusWBJE7oM_8ETgrrEWzwVXrOXKSuFRQ7iT51gyEb-daAqwSXKc1Gn0-GH6tIuBs9a2-1QJ3_1XYBAU0vs9N8ahM3CcUdipX4xXp-72MZ1-nrDGEw1x9UoZwAgSPhwvJ_fUHLT4z0IOANZ4BptANOC4lvmUpgH5Y-Vl9jCrzDXp5LzY0cVu0Uj7HpHpAhp15GgiDsv1fg3pJ11U)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF19uCc4wObCpbqsRkgW86TLFmkuhxSi4mK4N6gO6zWJrXoi_97cOi0FfN75rZbWetjye5c73JRxmE5PhLvBFwCnGYBdTJaT8hBAd4svp9dWxgC2sfJGEQCd44-2TyJoiqPDCQwEsspQaQ3XqwSKVDHtVAOL-8QS4gaLrphiiumqTYOkkA5kUb)

### What Actually Matters

- **Total alcohol consumed:** Your body reacts to the total amount of ethanol you drink, not the sequence of beverages.
- **Speed of consumption:** Your liver processes roughly one standard drink per hour. Drinking quickly spikes your blood alcohol level.
- **Impaired pacing:** Starting with beer can lower inhibitions, making it easier to drink stronger spirits faster later in the night.
- **Other factors:** Drinking on an empty stomach, dehydration, poor sleep, and drinks high in congeners (like dark liquors) can all worsen how you feel.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfAHEIkXXcbYZqcrZ2x7BWFYfUVrW4Qz9_zEYlFAVHtK-UqTh1rkyeLHv2jLb62GLh2IQZrDD_qhczIaLWmcjteW_rC7aNiiGBxm9Q-eU6NJzHVk8JdKKwEBjKwy8Gq2Wpuym6S4dCFudTn52-34-TIYQTLcOqP8JeL0B9I4)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEStwEBxCJF13myxvBNJsI58wMEJsz-4zyWTVYMuWSpGusWBJE7oM_8ETgrrEWzwVXrOXKSuFRQ7iT51gyEb-daAqwSXKc1Gn0-GH6tIuBs9a2-1QJ3_1XYBAU0vs9N8ahM3CcUdipX4xXp-72MZ1-nrDGEw1x9UoZwAgSPhwvJ_fUHLT4z0IOANZ4BptANOC4lvmUpgH5Y-Vl9jCrzDXp5LzY0cVu0Uj7HpHpAhp15GgiDsv1fg3pJ11U)[[3]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiAEBxCJF1-cconu-oNsyZdaCBs4enj6mFdhj4fnO_oKBQe72Tsr4GF24eIzHVLK_1iCcUsCkxcU5iCAZh-jyeMeC6AfPODsI_BZXVR4qCUqfFgV4U0QSkLbs8kKSHnHr_thrubVL8eYCmG5E0FGXcGcU4U0eXSRvx6mnlHZMu7xFrdNWOjUqBxKb)[[4]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZQHEIkXXH0XG6ufhtJFYXFsFs3-75BRCv9sGJ7_JqLKOl7lOMPC8gBpSSbIoUDdLZpbFDSNhEdSqfIbALSmRUBnsjLvaK1SHtuLElPrgo2Y5m1hiccaWUu2jBPwM-QjTrsruzAIy)[[5]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF1w64bxkyvYFM5Z62ViTPQhttIdHkalY3gTJ9HrTtFesDE6ZlHC0fZ21TyEJWx8dOasC_8jUAT5Fye-hlnxHbUtSx7sh5txy980tmyCtTL_AFQUak8cAI0vwuk5XDzu1t2FqR0k6SrJzyDPsz1K4NAIzjjU9xLyORSNBeoDnSSUN0dqs)[[6]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESZgHEIkXX5_ku6EzAAe-jooubpZ4euj1zq9yHpA_YqtaUBwKS7NuMMdfB-p1E5fnr-3CzsSAb7hi3PcyUHlJfpYCQqggpOkP4XjqBc3nQRLgyTnVt8eE_RBKyH6JFikTA4kkP0mfUUA)[[7]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESwgEBxCJF1yleBohu_wch3R_nLflqvhRya35VIl8Wi3Il6ihAho5p0H9jQepYtq6Ap4nPzEKlIUNglKUNJipm2qjRzzx-4SSYuuXQ1rfxjv8QITuoJ5RLOZonM2BTMMj5IlUTPmcAytFrRNbdK_kCXnyIqdLf0CTUMnkJfj34OiU4eZbcsVSGJFyktt1fv7G6pijp-HRADEM7nnU4mr22Z-uiTvViD0WIsj8LRd51KbXgsg2qlPZwa2qqmW-WUHQnw6BkRQ)[[8]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESiwEBxCJF19uCc4wObCpbqsRkgW86TLFmkuhxSi4mK4N6gO6zWJrXoi_97cOi0FfN75rZbWetjye5c73JRxmE5PhLvBFwCnGYBdTJaT8hBAd4svp9dWxgC2sfJGEQCd44-2TyJoiqPDCQwEsspQaQ3XqwSKVDHtVAOL-8QS4gaLrphiiumqTYOkkA5kUb)
